description: Department of  Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 994 - Order made to direct that a license fee for arrack Licenses which are issued together with foreign Liquor License and for the sale of bottled toddy be charged w.e.f. 01.01.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Excise Ordinance, exercising powers granted by specific sections of that legislation. It establishes new license fees for arrack and toddy sales, which constitutes a regulatory change. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters (amending excise regulations and fees) rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the regulatory action being taken.
